response.sql: WITH status_rates AS (SELECT t.healtheval, AVG(s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS scan_count FROM scans AS s JOIN sites AS t ON s.zoneref = t.zoneregistry GROUP BY t.healtheval), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS all_status_rate FROM status_rates) SELECT AVG(sr.rate) AS average_rate, AVG(sr.scan_count) AS average_count, AVG(sr.rate - o.all_status_rate) AS average_excess_rate FROM status_rates AS sr CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE sr.rate > o.all_status_rate;

assumptions.assumption: The all-status average gives each health and safety status equal weight; the count includes every matched scan in that status. Zero-minute scans have no defined rate and are excluded from rate averages.

alternatives.interpretation: The all-status average is the pooled average rate across matched scans, giving statuses with more valid scans more weight.
alternatives.sql: WITH matched AS (SELECT t.healtheval, s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0) AS scan_rate FROM scans AS s JOIN sites AS t ON s.zoneref = t.zoneregistry), status_rates AS (SELECT healtheval, AVG(scan_rate) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS scan_count FROM matched GROUP BY healtheval), overall AS (SELECT AVG(scan_rate) AS all_status_rate FROM matched) SELECT AVG(sr.rate) AS average_rate, AVG(sr.scan_count) AS average_count, AVG(sr.rate - o.all_status_rate) AS average_excess_rate FROM status_rates AS sr CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE sr.rate > o.all_status_rate;
